name: SoRI-9409
summary: SoRI-9409 is a mixed mu opioid receptor partial agonist and delta opioid receptor antagonist, used in biomedical research. It produces moderate analgesic effects without development of tolerance and with reduced withdrawal symptoms compared to standard opioid analgesics, as well as showing anti-addictive effects that may be useful in the treatment of alcoholism.

pharmacology.text: SoRI-9409 is a mixed mu opioid receptor partial agonist and delta opioid receptor antagonist, used in biomedical research.

uses.text: SoRI-9409 is a mixed mu opioid receptor partial agonist and delta opioid receptor antagonist, used in biomedical research. It produces moderate analgesic effects without development of tolerance and with reduced withdrawal symptoms compared to standard opioid analgesics, as well as showing anti-addictive effects that may be useful in the treatment of alcoholism.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that switch on the mu opioid receptor can cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and dependence, and in overdose they slow breathing, which can be fatal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。會活化μ鴉片受體的藥物可能造成嗜睡、噁心、便秘與依賴，過量時會抑制呼吸，可能致命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。会活化μ鸦片受体的药物可能造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与依赖，过量时会抑制呼吸，可能致命。

fact.en: It packs two actions into one molecule: it partly switches on mu opioid receptors while blocking delta opioid receptors. Researchers took this approach because delta receptor blockade may lessen tolerance.
fact.zh: 它在一個分子中結合了兩種作用：部分活化μ鴉片受體，同時阻斷δ鴉片受體。研究者採用這種設計，是因為阻斷δ受體可能減少耐受性的產生。
fact.zhHans: 它在一个分子中结合了两种作用：部分活化μ鸦片受体，同时阻断δ鸦片受体。研究者采用这种设计，是因为阻断δ受体可能减少耐受性的产生。
